results.title: Animals: Drugs, Sex and Fun!
results.overview: It was long believed that animals only played to learn, only mated to reproduce and only took drugs by accident. But sometimes, they just do it for fun! Research has revealed that animals seek for pleasure just like humans do, and that there are many ways in which they enjoy themselves. Did you know that rats loved to play hide-and-seek? That primates played erotic games to ease tensions within their groups? Or that reindeers were quite fond of hallucinogenic mushrooms? Scientists show that this quest for pleasure – as wild as it can get – might even be a key of evolution and biodiversity! Combining the testimonies of international ethologists, scientific archives and sequences showing the animals in their natural habitats, this unusual documentary reveals the complexity of animal pleasure.

results.title: In the Opinion of the Censor...
results.original_title: In the Opinion of the Censor...
results.overview: A feature-length documentary that tells the story of the Censorship of Films Act 1923 and how one  canny term in that statute has allowed consecutive holders of the role of Film Censor to reflect the prevailing values of Irish society over the last 100 years.

results.title: Boca Vieja
results.overview: Boca Vieja, where my maternal roots lie, is a quaint fishing and farming village in southern Mexico. Here, people live in harmony with the land and sea, but each rainy season forces them to retreat, letting nature reclaim its space. This cycle persists as the village faces the constant threat of losing their land.

results.title: Her Turn
results.overview: The isolated mansion is hidden with deadly traps, and the lives of the people in the game are hanging by a thread and full of suspense! The film tells the story of a paraplegic girl, He Siyi, who returns home after 17 years away from home on a strange island. What awaits her is a beautiful and gentle stepmother, a charming personal doctor, a young and strong driver, and a caring maid. What kind of abyss of eternal damnation is hidden behind the mask? A long-planned revenge drama is gradually unfolding.

results.title: Homeland In Our Hearts: The Concert Film
results.original_title: TỔ QUỐC TRONG TIM: THE CONCERT FILM
results.overview: Following the brilliant success of the National Concert – Homeland In My Heart held on August 10th at My Dinh National Stadium, along with the anticipation and requests from the large public, Nhan Dan Newspaper decided to bring Homeland In My Heart: The Concert Film. This film not only recreates a historical cultural and artistic event but is also a way to deeply spread love for the Fatherland and national pride.

results.title: Matrescence
results.overview: A first-time mother struggles to navigate the difficulties of postnatal depression.

results.title: The Mixtape for The End of The World
results.original_title: The Mixtape for The End of The World
results.overview: Set in the late '80s, ambitious 15-year-old Milo uncovers an imminent asteroid threat and enlists his best friend Olivia for a chaotic journey to warn NASA. As they race against time, fantasy blurs with reality, and they must decide if their friendship is worth more than their mission to save the world.

results.title: We Are The Żugajkas
results.overview: A music and dance story about the phenomenon of the popular and adored by teenage girls Julia Zugaj. The influencer, youtuber and singer has built one of the largest and most devoted online communities in just a few years.

results.title: Twin Fantasy
results.overview: Hayden, a recluse, is kept company by her loving girlfriend, Robin. A sudden announcement tests their wellbeings and the bonds of their relationship.

results.title: Electronic Voice
results.overview: Electricity flows through the water of a fountain, under the scorching heat of Madrid's summer sun. Lando, a young office worker, disappears into an illusion. His girlfriend and his brother, must then join forces to find him, wherever it is he went...finding themselves deeply lost in a paranormal mystery, a tale about escapism and connection.

results.title: Bench
results.overview: A couple meet on a park bench to discuss a life-changing secret.

results.title: The Curfew
results.overview: When Ayaan becomes a temporary caregiver for his grandmother, they find themselves adrift in the gulf of a language barrier. In the silence, specters of a colonial past shift how he sees strangers and himself.

results.title: Fuck My Son!
results.overview: An X-Rated descent into demented comedy and maniacal horror, as a desperate mother drags an innocent stranger into an absurd, filthy nightmare beyond comprehension. An unflinchingly loyal adaptation of transgressive artist Johnny Ryan’s joyfully disgusting comic book. Adults only.

results.title: The Scene
results.overview: A young filmmaker attempts to direct a scene with an inexperienced crew.

results.title: Insomniac
results.overview: A sleep deprived girl's reality is challenged when her dream world bleeds into the real world.

results.title: Mozart: Lausanne Chamber Orchestra Ton Koopman and Julia Lezhneva
results.original_title: Mozart: Lausanne Chamber Orchestra Ton Koopman and Julia Lezhneva
results.overview: When he composed his motet ‘Exsultate jubilate’ K.165, Mozart was only 17 years old. He was then at the height of his fame. He was 35 when he wrote ‘The Magic Flute’ and died shortly afterwards. Dutch conductor Ton Koopman presents a programme that traces the stages of the composer's life. Russian soprano Julia Lezhneva performs the solo parts.

results.title: Le Pont du vaisseau
results.overview: Diane has stopped counting the years that fly by. Now, isolated, she kills time fishing, watching the days pass and repeat themselves despite the hustle and bustle of the 2024 Olympics project. On the eve of a planned departure, Diane lingers on the quays of Austerlitz, looking for catfish, before heading to the bridge of the ship. The Bridge of the Ship concludes a summer trilogy in the capital filmed over three summers.

results.title: Meet Me Again
results.overview: During a night out, Álmos, a queer teenager, discovers that his partner and friend have been lying to him. What begins as a painful experience soon turns into a journey of self-discovery, leading him to reconnect with a part of himself he thought was lost.

results.title: Pick One
results.overview: It’s Danny’s wedding day, and he has a big choice to make. Cue the insanity. Pick One is a chaotic bisexual Italian wedding rom-com... with a porchetta.
